name: James Halloran
summary: In Menethil Harbor, James Halloran tans crocolisk hides for a living. Passing travelers and nearby trade carry raw skins to him and finished leather to buyers across the eastern continents.

sections.title: A Tanner in the Marshes
sections.body: James Halloran earns his living from the marsh just outside Menethil Harbor. Its dangerous bogs supply crocolisk skins, which he turns into fine leather with rare skill. Nearby trade carries his finished goods to buyers across Azeroth.

sections.title: Hides, Apprentices, and Daily Trade
sections.body: Near the marsh, Halloran tends his curing vats and trade arrangements while danger remains close. He hires hardy travelers to skin young marsh beasts and make routine deliveries between his work site and nearby settlements. Their help supplies his craft while he manages the tanning and trade.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a human tanner in Menethil Harbor. He hunts and skins the region’s crocolisks, then cures their tough hides into leather for buyers across the world.

faq.q: Where does James Halloran sell his leather?
faq.answer: Halloran ships his fine leather throughout Azeroth. Maritime trade through Menethil Harbor carries his wares across the seas.

faq.q: Why does Halloran need adventurers to collect young crocolisk skins?
faq.answer: Tanning and curing keep Halloran busy at his workshop. He hires traveling adventurers to cull local marsh crocolisks and strip their hides, keeping his supply of raw material steady without leaving the workshop.

faq.q: What is Halloran's connection to Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is Halloran’s trade and supply hub. He relies on its shipping lanes to send cured hides to distant markets and keep his tanning business viable.

faq.q: Where can James Halloran be found?
faq.answer: James Halloran lives and works in Menethil Harbor, on the western coast of the Wetlands. Crocolisk marshes lie just outside town.

Yes. Halloran sent his apprentice, whom he thinks of like a son, into the marshes to skin giant crocolisks. The young man was mauled and lost a leg. While he recovers, Halloran relies on hardy travelers to gather the skins his trade needs.

angles.text: Halloran’s trade supports the Alliance’s commercial presence in the rugged Wetlands. He supplies valuable crafted leather to towns across the kingdom.
As a hunter, you may find common ground with Halloran. His livelihood depends on stalking and harvesting the Wetlands’ aggressive reptilian predators.
